Message:
refactor(Vine): Inline trivial provider unregistration and renderer-relay atoms

Consolidate the Notification module by removing files that perform single-step delegation or pure relay operations. Moved `OutputChannelCreate`, `OutputChannelClear`, `OutputChannelDispose`, `OutputChannelShow`, `OutputChannelHide`, `OutputChannelReplace`, `OutputAppend`, `OutputClear`, `OutputCreate`, `OutputDispose`, `OutputShow`, `OutputReplace`, `ProgressComplete`, `ProgressUpdate`, `WindowShowTextDocument`, `WorkspaceApplyEdit`, `ExtensionActivated`, `ExtensionDeactivated`, `TreeRefresh`, `ExtensionHostMessage`, `WebviewReady`, `WindowShowMessage`, `UnregisterFileSystemProvider`, and `UnregisterUriHandler` directly into the Mountain dispatcher as inline handlers.

Retain only atoms with genuine multi-step orchestration: `OutputChannelCoalesce` (channel-drain coalescer), `WebviewLifecycle` (positional-to-named-key reshape), `UnregisterScmProvider` (DJB-31 handle recomputation), and other handlers combining payload extraction, channel management, or multiple side effects.

Update module documentation to clarify the new contract: files here encapsulate non-trivial logic (payload reshape, coalescing, multi-effect coordination), while pure relays live inline in the dispatch layer.

This reduces the notification file count by ~40% while preserving all unregistration pathways, UI event mappings, and observability hooks.
